description: Side-by-side comparison of Hydrogen and Helium Bohr atoms, demonstrating the scale method and layout.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import BohrAtom

class BohrAtomComparison(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        h = BohrAtom(e=1, p=1, n=0).scale(0.7).shift(LEFT * 3)
        he = BohrAtom(e=2, p=2, n=2).scale(0.7).shift(RIGHT * 3)
        h_label = Text("H", font_size=24).next_to(h, DOWN)
        he_label = Text("He", font_size=24).next_to(he, DOWN)
        self.add(h, he, h_label, he_label)
        self.wait(0.5)
